answer_2.quote: We measure topical alignment using three external clustering metrics (harmonic mean purity, normalized mutual information, and adjusted Rand index)

answer_4.quote: Our human evaluation received approval from an institutional review board. All annotators (US-based) gave their informed consent...
answer_4.guideline: Manual topic mapping process: Three annotators... assigned each topic to a ground truth class... labeled as one of the three misaligned categories: 1. Out-of-scope: topics that are too narrow/broad compared to the associated ground truth. 2. Repeated: topics that are unnecessary repeats or very similar to others. 3. Missing: essential categories that appear in the true categories but are absent.
